content: For a long-running FastAPI+APScheduler process on free hosting in 2026, container/VM platforms (Render, Railway) are required, not serverless FaaS; Render's spin-down and Koyeb's scale-to-zero both kill in-process schedulers when idle - mitigate with an external keep-alive ping (UptimeRobot/cron-job.org hitting a /health endpoint every ~10 min) or use Railway's non-sleeping trial credit for the demo window.
